# Command reference

<!-- Generated by tools/make_reference.py from the command table; do not edit. -->

Every command of wordgenx, with where it may appear, what its body holds and every option,
followed by every formatting property. To learn the language, start with the
[guide](guide/README.md); this page is for looking things up. The same facts are a command away:
`wordgenx explain table`, `wordgenx explain space-before`.

**Reading the entries.** A command is written `\name[options]{body}`. Options are `name=value`,
separated by commas; an option that is on or off may be written alone (`[keep-with-next]` is
`keep-with-next=on`). Where an entry names a *positional* option, its value may be written without
the name: `\list[Legal]` is `\list[numbering=Legal]`. A value written `(a=..., b=...)` is a
group: `margins=(top=2cm, left=3cm)`; where the group has a main field, a single value is enough
(`margins=2.5cm`). Lengths take `pt`, `cm`, `mm`, `in` or `pc`; colours are `#RRGGBB`, a name or
`theme.accent1`. *Text* is a word, a `"string"` or `{plain text}`.

**Placement.** *A block of its own* means the command stands alone, between blank lines. *Inside
text* means it goes in a paragraph. Commands for parts (`\row`, `\cell`) go only directly inside
their parent.

**Not commands.** The short forms (`= Heading`, `1.` lists, pipe tables, `*strong*`, `_emphasis_`,
`@label`, `$$` display math, code fences, `%` comments) and the definitions `\define` and `\let`
are described in the [syntax guide](guide/syntax.md) and the [macro guide](guide/macros.md).

## Commands by topic

- **Preamble: the document as a whole:** [`\document`](#cmd-document), [`\meta`](#cmd-meta), [`\settings`](#cmd-settings), [`\use`](#cmd-use), [`\include`](#cmd-include), [`\styles`](#cmd-styles), [`\bibliography`](#cmd-bibliography)
- **Paragraphs, lists and tab stops:** [`\p`](#cmd-p), [`\align`](#cmd-align), [`\list`](#cmd-list), [`\tabs`](#cmd-tabs)
- **Sections, headers and footers:** [`\section`](#cmd-section), [`\header`](#cmd-header), [`\footer`](#cmd-footer), [`\watermark`](#cmd-watermark)
- **Tables:** [`\table`](#cmd-table), [`\row`](#cmd-row), [`\cell`](#cmd-cell)
- **Captions, contents and the index:** [`\caption`](#cmd-caption), [`\figure`](#cmd-figure), [`\toc`](#cmd-toc), [`\listof`](#cmd-listof), [`\index`](#cmd-index), [`\ix`](#cmd-ix), [`\printbibliography`](#cmd-printbibliography)
- **Text formatting:** [`\b`](#cmd-b), [`\i`](#cmd-i), [`\u`](#cmd-u), [`\s`](#cmd-s), [`\sup`](#cmd-sup), [`\sub`](#cmd-sub), [`\hidden`](#cmd-hidden), [`\hl`](#cmd-hl), [`\strong`](#cmd-strong), [`\emph`](#cmd-emph), [`\code`](#cmd-code), [`\font`](#cmd-font), [`\style`](#cmd-style), [`\lang`](#cmd-lang)
- **Links, references and notes:** [`\link`](#cmd-link), [`\url`](#cmd-url), [`\ref`](#cmd-ref), [`\pageref`](#cmd-pageref), [`\footnote`](#cmd-footnote), [`\endnote`](#cmd-endnote), [`\cite`](#cmd-cite), [`\textcite`](#cmd-textcite), [`\comment`](#cmd-comment)
- **Fields and counters:** [`\pagenum`](#cmd-pagenum), [`\numpages`](#cmd-numpages), [`\sectionpages`](#cmd-sectionpages), [`\date`](#cmd-date), [`\field`](#cmd-field), [`\seq`](#cmd-seq)
- **Breaks:** [`\br`](#cmd-br), [`\tab`](#cmd-tab), [`\pagebreak`](#cmd-pagebreak), [`\columnbreak`](#cmd-columnbreak)
- **Pictures, text boxes and forms:** [`\image`](#cmd-image), [`\textbox`](#cmd-textbox), [`\control`](#cmd-control), [`\embed-docx`](#cmd-embed-docx)
- **Math:** [`\math`](#cmd-math), [`\m`](#cmd-m)
- **Escape hatches:** [`\raw`](#cmd-raw)
- **Not implemented:** [`\ins`](#cmd-ins), [`\del`](#cmd-del)

Code blocks take options too: see [code blocks](#cmd-code-block).

## Preamble: the document as a whole

<a id="cmd-document"></a>
### `\document`

Document-wide choices: language, smart quotes, template.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** none.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `lang` | language tag, e.g. en-US | the document language (en-US) |
| `smart-quotes` | on \| off | curly quotes and dashes |
| `template` | text | a .dotx or .docx to compile into |
| `page-color` | #RRGGBB \| auto \| theme.<name> | the colour of every page |

<a id="cmd-meta"></a>
### `\meta`

Document properties (File > Info).

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** none.
- **Also takes** `custom.NAME=value`: "text", a number, or true/false.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `title` | text | the document title |
| `subject` | text | its subject |
| `author` | text | its author (also the default author of comments) |
| `description` | text | a summary (Comments in File > Info) |
| `last-modified-by` | text | who saved it last |
| `keywords` | a list of text | tags: (a, b) or "a, b" |

<a id="cmd-settings"></a>
### `\settings`

Document settings (settings.xml).

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** none.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `even-odd-headers` | on \| off | different headers and footers on even pages |
| `mirror-margins` | on \| off | facing pages: inside and outside margins |
| `update-fields-on-open` | on \| off | Word updates all fields when it opens the document |
| `default-tab-stop` | a length such as 12pt or 2.5cm | the distance between default tab stops |
| `footnotes` | (format=..., restart=..., position=..., start=...) | footnote numbering and position |
| `endnotes` | (format=..., restart=..., position=..., start=...) | endnote numbering and position |
| `protection` | (mode=..., enforce) | restrict editing in Word: forms, read-only, comments or tracked-changes |
| `code-theme` | one of abap \| algol \| algol_nu \| arduino \| autumn \| borland \| bw \| coffee \| colorful \| default \| dracula \| emacs \| ... | the Pygments style for code blocks |
| `captions` | (chapter-numbers, chapter-style=..., separator=...) | caption numbers with the chapter number: 2-1, 2.1, ... |
| `track-changes` | on \| off | Word's Track Changes on for edits made in Word |
| `hyphenation` | one of auto \| off | hyphenate the document automatically |

<a id="cmd-use"></a>
### `\use`

A style sheet (.wgxs), macro file or std:module.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** a file name, read as is (only `\}` and `\\` are escapes).

<a id="cmd-include"></a>
### `\include`

The blocks of another .wgx file.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** a file name, read as is (only `\}` and `\\` are escapes).

<a id="cmd-styles"></a>
### `\styles`

Style-sheet definitions in the document.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** style-sheet rules (see the style-sheet guide).

<a id="cmd-bibliography"></a>
### `\bibliography`

The bibliography data and citation style.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** none.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `file` (required) | a list of text | BibTeX or CSL-JSON files |
| `style` | text | a bundled CSL style or a .csl file |

## Paragraphs, lists and tab stops

<a id="cmd-p"></a>
### `\p`

A paragraph with a style or direct paragraph formatting.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** text and commands.
- **Also takes** every one of the [paragraph properties](#paragraph-properties) as an option.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `style` | text | a paragraph style |
| `id` | text | a label to refer to this with @label |
| `drop-cap` | on \| off \| (lines=..., in-margin) | a large first letter over the first lines |

<a id="cmd-align"></a>
### `\align`

Aligns the paragraphs inside.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** text and commands.
- **Positional option:** `align`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `align` (required) | one of left \| center \| right \| justify \| distribute | the alignment |

<a id="cmd-list"></a>
### `\list`

A list with a named numbering definition.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** text and commands.
- **Positional option:** `numbering`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `numbering` (required) | text | the numbering definition |
| `continue` | on \| off | continue the previous list of this numbering |
| `restart` | a whole number of at least 0 | the number to start at |

<a id="cmd-tabs"></a>
### `\tabs`

Tab stops for the paragraphs inside.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** text and commands.
- **Positional option:** `stops` (several values: each one).

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `stops` | a tab stop such as (8cm, center) or (16cm, right, leader=dot) | the tab stops, one value each |

## Sections, headers and footers

<a id="cmd-section"></a>
### `\section`

Page setup; after content it also starts a new section.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** none.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `size` | A3 \| A4 \| A5 \| Letter \| Legal \| (width, height) | the paper size |
| `orientation` | one of portrait \| landscape | the page orientation |
| `margins` | (all=..., top=..., bottom=..., left=..., right=..., inside=..., outside=...) | the page margins: one length, or by side |
| `gutter` | a length such as 12pt or 2.5cm | extra margin for binding |
| `header-distance` | a length such as 12pt or 2.5cm | from the top edge to the header |
| `footer-distance` | a length such as 12pt or 2.5cm | from the bottom edge to the footer |
| `break` | one of next-page \| continuous \| even-page \| odd-page \| next-column | how the section starts |
| `page-numbers` | (format=..., start=...) | the page number format (decimal, lower-roman, ...) and first number |
| `columns` | (count=..., gap=..., separator, widths=...) | text columns: a count, or (count, gap, separator, widths) |
| `valign` | one of top \| center \| bottom \| justify | where the text sits on the page |
| `borders` | a border such as (single, 1pt, theme.accent1), or (all=..., top=..., left=..., bottom=..., right=..., from=page\|text, pages=all\|first\|not-first), or none | lines around the pages |
| `rtl` | on \| off | right to left: columns and the gutter from the right |
| `text-direction` | one of horizontal \| vertical | vertical: East Asian layout |
| `line-numbers` | on \| off \| (count-by=..., start=..., distance=..., restart=...) | line numbers in the margin |
| `link-headers` | on \| off | headers and footers continue from the previous section |
| `title-page` | on \| off | a different first page |
| `mirror` | on \| off | facing pages (mirror margins) |
| `separator` | on \| off | a line between columns |

<a id="cmd-header"></a>
### `\header`

The header of the current section.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** text and commands (optional).
- **Positional option:** `kind`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `kind` | one of default \| first \| even | every page, the first page, or even pages |

<a id="cmd-footer"></a>
### `\footer`

The footer of the current section.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** text and commands (optional).
- **Positional option:** `kind`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `kind` | one of default \| first \| even | every page, the first page, or even pages |

<a id="cmd-watermark"></a>
### `\watermark`

Text or a picture behind the text of every page of the section.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** none.
- **Positional option:** `text`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `text` | text | the words, such as DRAFT |
| `image` | text | a picture file instead of text |
| `color` | #RRGGBB \| auto \| theme.<name> | of the text (default: silver) |
| `font` | text | of the text (default: Calibri) |
| `layout` | one of diagonal \| horizontal | the direction of the text |
| `semitransparent` | on \| off | text at half opacity (default: on) |
| `washout` | on \| off | a pale picture (default: on) |
| `width` | a length (12cm) or a percentage of the text width (50%) | the size (default: as wide as the text allows) |
| `none` | on \| off | no watermark from this section on |

## Tables

<a id="cmd-table"></a>
### `\table`

A table of pipe rows and/or \row commands.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** text and commands.
- **Also takes** every one of the [table properties](#table-properties) as an option.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `style` | text | a table style, or none |
| `header-rows` | a whole number of at least 0 | rows repeated on each page |
| `widths` | a list of a length (4cm), a percentage of the text width (25%), or a fraction (1fr) | the column widths |
| `align` | one of left \| center \| right | the table between the margins |
| `columns` | a list of (align=..., tab=...) | paragraph alignment per column |
| `look` | none \| a tuple of header-row, last-row, first-column, last-column, banded-rows, banded-columns | table-style parts to apply |
| `float` | on \| off | positioned on the page, with text around it |
| `wrap` | one of square \| tight \| top-bottom \| behind \| front | how text flows around it (implies float) |
| `wrap-side` | one of both \| left \| right \| largest | where text goes beside it |
| `x` | (at=..., from=...) | the horizontal position (implies float) |
| `y` | (at=..., from=...) | the vertical position (implies float) |
| `distance` | (all=..., top=..., bottom=..., left=..., right=...) | space between it and the text |

<a id="cmd-row"></a>
### `\row`

A table row of \cell commands.

- **Where:** directly inside `\table`.
- **Body:** text and commands.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `header` | on \| off | repeat on each page |
| `cant-split` | on \| off | keep the row on one page |
| `height` | 1cm \| (1cm, exact) \| (1cm, at-least) | the row height: at least, or exactly |

<a id="cmd-cell"></a>
### `\cell`

A table cell: any blocks.

- **Where:** directly inside `\row`.
- **Body:** text and commands (optional).
- **Also takes** every one of the [cell properties](#cell-properties) as an option.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `colspan` | a whole number of at least 1 | the number of columns it spans |
| `rowspan` | a whole number of at least 1 | the number of rows it spans |
| `shade` | #RRGGBB \| theme.<name> | the cell's background |
| `valign` | one of top \| center \| bottom | where the content sits in a taller cell |
| `align` | one of left \| center \| right \| justify \| distribute | paragraph alignment |

## Captions, contents and the index

<a id="cmd-caption"></a>
### `\caption`

A numbered caption; the kind defaults from the neighbouring block.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** text and commands.
- **Positional option:** `kind`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `kind` | text | Figure, Table, Listing, ... |
| `id` | text | a label to refer to this with @label |

<a id="cmd-figure"></a>
### `\figure`

An image and its caption, kept together.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** text and commands.
- **Also takes** every one of the [paragraph properties](#paragraph-properties) as an option.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `id` | text | a label to refer to this with @label |
| `width` | a length (12cm) or a percentage of the text width (50%) | the image width |

<a id="cmd-toc"></a>
### `\toc`

A table of contents.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** none.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `levels` | levels such as 1-3 | the heading levels listed (default 1-3) |
| `title` | text | a heading above it |
| `hyperlinks` | on \| off | always on |

<a id="cmd-listof"></a>
### `\listof`

A list of figures, tables, ...

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** none.
- **Positional option:** `kind`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `kind` | text | the caption kind |
| `title` | text | a heading above it |

<a id="cmd-index"></a>
### `\index`

The index of the \ix entries.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** none.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `columns` | a whole number from 1 to 4 | the number of columns |
| `headings` | on \| off | letter headings |
| `right-align` | on \| off | page numbers at the right, after dots |
| `title` | text | a heading above it |
| `level` | a whole number from 1 to 9 | the heading level |

<a id="cmd-ix"></a>
### `\ix`

An index entry; ! separates subentries.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** a term, read as is (only `\}` and `\\` are escapes).

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `see` | text | "See ..." instead of a page number |
| `see-also` | text | "See also ..." after the page numbers |
| `xref` | text | the whole cross-reference text, in any language |
| `bold` | on \| off | a bold page number |
| `italic` | on \| off | an italic page number |

<a id="cmd-printbibliography"></a>
### `\printbibliography`

The cited entries (or all of them).

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** none.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `title` | text | a heading, or none |
| `level` | a whole number from 1 to 9 | the heading level |
| `all` | on \| off | every entry in the data, cited or not |

### `\b`

- **Body:** text and commands.

- **Body:** text and commands.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.
- **Positional option:** `underline`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `underline` | single \| words \| double \| thick \| dotted \| dotted-heavy \| dash \| dashed-heavy \| dash-long \| dash-long-heavy \| dot-dash \| dash-dot-heavy \| dot-dot-dash \| dash-dot-dot-heavy \| wave \| wavy-heavy \| wavy-double \| none | single, double, ... |

<a id="cmd-s"></a>
### `\s`

Text in strikethrough.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.

<a id="cmd-sup"></a>
### `\sup`

Text in superscript.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.

<a id="cmd-sub"></a>
### `\sub`

Text in subscript.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.

<a id="cmd-hidden"></a>
### `\hidden`

Text in hidden text.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.

<a id="cmd-hl"></a>
### `\hl`

Highlighted text.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.
- **Positional option:** `highlight`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `highlight` | black \| blue \| cyan \| green \| magenta \| red \| yellow \| white \| dark-blue \| dark-cyan \| dark-green \| dark-magenta \| dark-red \| dark-yellow \| dark-gray \| light-gray \| none | yellow, green, ... |

<a id="cmd-strong"></a>
### `\strong`

Text in the Strong style.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.

<a id="cmd-emph"></a>
### `\emph`

Text in the Emphasis style.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.

<a id="cmd-code"></a>
### `\code`

Text in the Code style.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.

<a id="cmd-font"></a>
### `\font`

Text with direct run formatting.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.

<a id="cmd-style"></a>
### `\style`

Text in a character style.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.
- **Positional option:** `style`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `style` (required) | text | a character style |

<a id="cmd-lang"></a>
### `\lang`

Text in another language.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.
- **Positional option:** `lang`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `lang` (required) | language tag, e.g. en-US | a language tag: de-DE |

## Links, references and notes

<a id="cmd-link"></a>
### `\link`

A hyperlink.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `to` (required) | text | the address |
| `style` | text | a character style for the text, or none (default: Hyperlink) |

<a id="cmd-url"></a>
### `\url`

A hyperlink showing its address.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** an address, read as is (only `\}` and `\\` are escapes).

<a id="cmd-ref"></a>
### `\ref`

A cross-reference to a label.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** a label, read as is (only `\}` and `\\` are escapes).
- **Positional option:** `form`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `form` | one of default \| number \| text \| full \| page \| above-below \| relative | what is printed: Figure 3, 3, the text, ... |

<a id="cmd-pageref"></a>
### `\pageref`

The page of a label.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** a label, read as is (only `\}` and `\\` are escapes).

<a id="cmd-footnote"></a>
### `\footnote`

A footnote: the mark here, the text in the footnotes.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `id` | text | a label to refer to this with @label |

<a id="cmd-endnote"></a>
### `\endnote`

A endnote: the mark here, the text in the endnotes.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `id` | text | a label to refer to this with @label |

| `chapter` | text | a chapter locator: page=12 |
| `section` | text | a section locator: page=12 |
| `figure` | text | a figure locator: page=12 |
| `table` | text | a table locator: page=12 |

| `line` | text | a line locator: page=12 |

<a id="cmd-comment"></a>
### `\comment`

A comment in the margin on the text in the body (none: a point).

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands (optional).

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `text` (required) | text: {markup}, a word or a "string" | what the comment says |
| `author` | text | default: the document's author |
| `initials` | text | default: from the author's name |
| `date` | text | YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm (default: the build time) |

## Fields and counters

<a id="cmd-pagenum"></a>
### `\pagenum`

The page number (PAGE).

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** none.

<a id="cmd-numpages"></a>
### `\numpages`

The number of pages (NUMPAGES).

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** none.

<a id="cmd-sectionpages"></a>
### `\sectionpages`

The pages of the section (SECTIONPAGES).

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** none.

<a id="cmd-date"></a>
### `\date`

A date: fixed at build time, or a DATE / SAVEDATE / CREATEDATE field.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** none.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `kind` | one of fixed \| today \| saved \| created | fixed text, or a field Word updates |
| `format` | text | a Word date picture: "d MMMM yyyy" |

<a id="cmd-field"></a>
### `\field`

Any Word field; nested fields in { }.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** a field code, read as is (braces must balance).

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `result` | text | the text shown until Word updates the field |

<a id="cmd-seq"></a>
### `\seq`

A counter (SEQ field).

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** none.
- **Positional option:** `name`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `name` (required) | text | the counter (letters, digits, _) |
| `id` | text | a label to refer to this with @label |
| `restart` | heading-N \| N | after each heading of a level, or at a number |
| `format` | one of decimal \| lower-letter \| upper-letter \| lower-roman \| upper-roman | decimal, lower-letter, upper-roman, ... |

## Breaks

<a id="cmd-br"></a>
### `\br`

A line break.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** none.

<a id="cmd-tab"></a>
### `\tab`

A tab character.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** none.

<a id="cmd-pagebreak"></a>
### `\pagebreak`

A page break.

- **Where:** inside text, or alone as a block.
- **Body:** none.

<a id="cmd-columnbreak"></a>
### `\columnbreak`

A column break.

- **Where:** inside text, or alone as a block.
- **Body:** none.

## Pictures, text boxes and forms

<a id="cmd-image"></a>
### `\image`

A picture (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP or SVG), inline or floating.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** a file name, read as is (only `\}` and `\\` are escapes).

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `width` | a length (12cm) or a percentage of the text width (50%) | the width (the height follows) |
| `height` | a length such as 12pt or 2.5cm | the height (the width follows) |
| `alt` | text | a description |
| `name` | text | its name in Word (Selection pane) |
| `fallback` | text | a PNG or JPEG that Word 2013 and older show for an SVG |
| `float` | on \| off | positioned on the page, with text around it |
| `wrap` | one of square \| tight \| top-bottom \| behind \| front | how text flows around it (implies float) |
| `wrap-side` | one of both \| left \| right \| largest | where text goes beside it |
| `x` | (at=..., from=...) | the horizontal position (implies float) |
| `y` | (at=..., from=...) | the vertical position (implies float) |
| `distance` | (all=..., top=..., bottom=..., left=..., right=...) | space between it and the text |
| `crop` | (left=..., top=..., right=..., bottom=...) | how much to cut off each side |
| `rotate` | a whole number from -360 to 360 | degrees clockwise |
| `border` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | a line around the picture |

<a id="cmd-textbox"></a>
### `\textbox`

A text box: blocks in a frame, inline or floating.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `width` | a length (12cm) or a percentage of the text width (50%) | default: the text width |
| `height` | a length such as 12pt or 2.5cm | default: as tall as its text |
| `fill` | #RRGGBB \| auto \| theme.<name> | the background colour |
| `border` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | a line around it |
| `padding` | (all=..., top=..., bottom=..., left=..., right=...) | space between the frame and the text |
| `valign` | one of top \| center \| bottom | where the text sits in a taller box |
| `rotate` | a whole number from -360 to 360 | degrees clockwise |
| `name` | text | its name in Word (Selection pane) |
| `float` | on \| off | positioned on the page, with text around it |
| `wrap` | one of square \| tight \| top-bottom \| behind \| front | how text flows around it (implies float) |
| `wrap-side` | one of both \| left \| right \| largest | where text goes beside it |
| `x` | (at=..., from=...) | the horizontal position (implies float) |
| `y` | (at=..., from=...) | the vertical position (implies float) |
| `distance` | (all=..., top=..., bottom=..., left=..., right=...) | space between it and the text |

<a id="cmd-control"></a>
### `\control`

A content control: a field to fill in Word (the body: its value).

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** text and commands (optional).
- **Positional option:** `type`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `type` | one of text \| rich-text \| dropdown \| combo \| date \| checkbox \| picture | default: text |
| `tag` | text | a name for programs that read the form |
| `title` | text | shown on the control in Word |
| `placeholder` | text | grey text shown until it is filled in |
| `lock` | one of content \| control \| both | what cannot be edited or deleted |
| `items` | a list of text | the choices of a dropdown or combo box |
| `format` | text | a date's display format, as Word's (d MMMM yyyy) |
| `date` | text | a date's value, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `checked` | on \| off | a checkbox that is ticked |
| `width` | a length such as 12pt or 2.5cm | an empty picture control's size (4cm) |
| `height` | a length such as 12pt or 2.5cm | (3cm) |

<a id="cmd-embed-docx"></a>
### `\embed-docx`

Another .docx, which Word merges in when it opens the document.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** a file name, read as is (only `\}` and `\\` are escapes).

## Math

<a id="cmd-math"></a>
### `\math`

A display equation.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** a formula in LaTeX notation.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `id` | text | a label to refer to this with @label |
| `numbered` | on \| off | numbered even without an id (off: not even with one) |
| `nonumber` | on \| off | not numbered, even with an id |

<a id="cmd-m"></a>
### `\m`

An inline formula.

- **Where:** inside text.
- **Body:** a formula in LaTeX notation.

## Escape hatches

<a id="cmd-raw"></a>
### `\raw`

Raw WordprocessingML (block or inline, by its elements).

- **Where:** inside text, or alone as a block.
- **Body:** XML, read as is (braces must balance).
- **Positional option:** `format`.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `format` | one of ooxml | the markup: ooxml |

## Not implemented

<a id="cmd-ins"></a>
### `\ins`

Tracked inserted text.

*Not implemented (postponed): ignored with a warning.*

<a id="cmd-del"></a>
### `\del`

Tracked deleted text.

*Not implemented (postponed): ignored with a warning.*

## Code blocks

<a id="cmd-code-block"></a>
### Code blocks

A fenced code block: ```python {#lst:x, caption=..., line-numbers}.

- **Where:** a block of its own.
- **Body:** none.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `id` | text | a label to refer to this with @label |
| `caption` | text | a Listing caption |
| `line-numbers` | on \| off | number the lines |
| `first-line` | a whole number of at least 0 | the number of the first line |
| `highlight` | on \| off | syntax colours (default: on when a language is given) |

## Formatting properties

Formatting is set with properties: as options of the commands that take them, and as
declarations in style sheets (`space-after: 6pt;`). The `ooxml.*` properties are escape
hatches: raw WordprocessingML, checked against the schemas.

### Character properties

Used in `\font[...]`, character styles, `\p` and paragraph styles.

| Property | Values | Meaning |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `font` | font name \| theme.major \| theme.minor | Font family (Latin text). |
| `bold` | on \| off | Bold (complex scripts too). |
| `italic` | on \| off | Italic (complex scripts too). |
| `caps` | on \| off | Display all letters as capitals. |
| `small-caps` | on \| off | Lower-case letters as small capitals. |
| `strike` | on \| off | Single strikethrough. |
| `double-strike` | on \| off | Double strikethrough. |
| `hidden` | on \| off | Hidden text. |
| `color` | #RRGGBB \| auto \| theme.<name> | Text color. |
| `emboss` | on \| off | Embossed (raised) text. |
| `imprint` | on \| off | Engraved (imprinted) text. |
| `outline` | on \| off | Outlined (hollow) letters. |
| `shadow` | on \| off | Shadowed text. |
| `scale` | 1%-600% | Horizontal scale of the characters (100% is normal). |
| `kerning` | length, e.g. 12pt | Kern pairs of letters from this font size up. |
| `character-spacing` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Expand (positive) or condense (negative) character spacing. |
| `size` | length, e.g. 11pt | Font size (whole or half points). |
| `position` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Raise (positive) or lower (negative) the text from the baseline. |
| `highlight` | black \| blue \| cyan \| green \| magenta \| red \| yellow \| white \| dark-blue \| dark-cyan \| dark-green \| dark-magenta \| dark-red \| dark-yellow \| dark-gray \| light-gray \| none | Highlighter color. |
| `border` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | A border around the text (Word's character border). |
| `shading` | #RRGGBB \| theme.<name> | Background colour behind the text (any colour; highlight has 16). |
| `underline` | single \| words \| double \| thick \| dotted \| dotted-heavy \| dash \| dashed-heavy \| dash-long \| dash-long-heavy \| dot-dash \| dash-dot-heavy \| dot-dot-dash \| dash-dot-dot-heavy \| wave \| wavy-heavy \| wavy-double \| none | Underline style. |
| `vertical-align` | baseline \| superscript \| subscript | Superscript or subscript. |
| `lang` | language tag, e.g. en-US | Language for proofing and hyphenation (Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, ... and Chinese, Japanese, Korean go where Word keeps complex-script and East Asian languages). |
| `rtl` | on \| off | Right-to-left text. |
| `complex-script` | on \| off | Format the text with its complex-script properties (w:cs). |
| `font-cs` | font name | Font for complex scripts (Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Indic). |
| `font-east-asian` | font name | Font for East Asian text (Chinese, Japanese, Korean). |
| `ooxml.rPr` | WordprocessingML elements, e.g. "<w:snapToGrid w:val='0'/>" | Raw w:rPr XML; its elements replace those wordgenx writes (escape hatch). |

### Paragraph properties

Used in `\p[...]`, `\figure[...]`, paragraph styles.

| Property | Values | Meaning |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `rtl` | on \| off | A right-to-left paragraph. |
| `keep-with-next` | on \| off | Keep on the same page as the next paragraph. |
| `keep-lines` | on \| off | Keep all lines of the paragraph on one page. |
| `page-break-before` | on \| off | Start on a new page. |
| `widow-control` | on \| off | Prevent widows and orphans. |
| `space-before` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Space above. |
| `space-after` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Space below. |
| `line-spacing` | multiple (e.g. 1.15) or LineSpacing.exact/at_least | Line spacing. |
| `indent-left` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Left indent. |
| `indent-right` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Right indent. |
| `first-line-indent` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Indent of the first line. |
| `hanging-indent` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Outdent of the first line. |
| `suppress-line-numbers` | on \| off | Leave the paragraph out of line numbering. |
| `suppress-hyphenation` | on \| off | Do not hyphenate the paragraph automatically. |
| `contextual-spacing` | on \| off | Ignore spacing between paragraphs of the same style. |
| `tabs` | e.g. 8cm center, 16cm right leader=dot | Tab stops: position, alignment and leader. |
| `align` | left \| center \| right \| justify \| distribute | Horizontal alignment. |
| `outline-level` | 1-9 | Outline level (1-9), as used by the navigation pane and TOC. |
| `border-top` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Paragraph border: top. |
| `border-left` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Paragraph border: left. |
| `border-bottom` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Paragraph border: bottom. |
| `border-right` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Paragraph border: right. |
| `border-between` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Paragraph border: between. |
| `border-bar` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Paragraph border: bar. |
| `shading` | #RRGGBB \| theme.<name> | Background colour of the paragraph. |
| `ooxml.pPr` | WordprocessingML elements, e.g. "<w:snapToGrid w:val='0'/>" | Raw w:pPr XML; its elements replace those wordgenx writes (escape hatch). |

### Table properties

Used in `\table[...]`, table styles.

| Property | Values | Meaning |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `border-top` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Table border: top. |
| `border-left` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Table border: left. |
| `border-bottom` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Table border: bottom. |
| `border-right` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Table border: right. |
| `border-inside-h` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Table border: inside h. |
| `border-inside-v` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Table border: inside v. |
| `cell-margin-top` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Default top margin inside cells. |
| `cell-margin-left` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Default left margin inside cells. |
| `cell-margin-bottom` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Default bottom margin inside cells. |
| `cell-margin-right` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Default right margin inside cells. |
| `rtl` | on \| off | Columns right to left. |
| `table-align` | left \| center \| right | Position of the table between the margins. |
| `table-indent` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | Indent of the table from the left margin. |
| `ooxml.tblPr` | WordprocessingML elements, e.g. "<w:snapToGrid w:val='0'/>" | Raw w:tblPr XML; its elements replace those wordgenx writes (escape hatch). |

### Cell properties

Used in `\cell[...]`, table styles.

| Property | Values | Meaning |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `border-top` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Cell border: top. |
| `border-left` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Cell border: left. |
| `border-bottom` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Cell border: bottom. |
| `border-right` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Cell border: right. |
| `border-inside-h` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Cell border: inside h. |
| `border-inside-v` | (style, width, colour, space=…) \| none | Cell border: inside v. |
| `shading` | #RRGGBB \| theme.<name> | Background colour of the cell. |
| `cell-margin-top` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | The top margin inside this cell (overrides the table's). |
| `cell-margin-left` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | The left margin inside this cell (overrides the table's). |
| `cell-margin-bottom` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | The bottom margin inside this cell (overrides the table's). |
| `cell-margin-right` | length (e.g. 12pt, 0.5cm) | The right margin inside this cell (overrides the table's). |
| `text-direction` | horizontal \| up \| down | Direction of the text in the cell: rotated up (bottom-to-top) or down. |
| `valign` | top \| center \| bottom | Vertical alignment of the cell content. |
| `ooxml.tcPr` | WordprocessingML elements, e.g. "<w:snapToGrid w:val='0'/>" | Raw w:tcPr XML; its elements replace those wordgenx writes (escape hatch). |
